independence_declaration.statement:
I am code-security-reviewer, session 1fcbceaa. I authored no implementation in the DG3 scope.

Authorship of the reviewed scope:
- The round-2 repairs: T-DG3-KBE-D (4175262) by kpi-benefits-engineer, T-DG3-ARCH-05 (ea8e2de) by solution-architect, and the D-081 renumbering by delivery-orchestrator.
- The rest of the DG3 candidate, as listed in my round-1 record: solution-architect, backend-workflow-engineer, kpi-benefits-engineer, frontend-ux-engineer, transformation-analyst and delivery-orchestrator.

What I reviewed: the frozen candidate directly. That is the product repair diff 928b7654..f49ca16 (20 files) and the full files it touches. I re-ran my round-1 probes A, B and C, and I wrote new probes D (inherited-approval annotation) and E (guard bypass).

Where code ran: only in disposable clones under $TMPDIR. review-r2 held the check harness; review-p2 held the probes; both used an offline frozen install. The PostgreSQL 16 clusters were throwaway, on ports 26301, 26302, 26310 and 26312. All of these were deleted afterwards.

I formed this verdict before reading any other reviewer's round-2 record, and I have read none.

checks_run.procedure: Probe E, part 1. Append each of the six round-1 bypass forms (O1-O6) to packages/shared/src/formula/evaluate.ts, one at a time. checks_run.command: node docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG3/code-security/round-2/probes/guard-bypass-probe.mjs $TMPDIR/review-p2; node .../guard-bypass-probe-supplement.mjs $TMPDIR/review-p2
checks_run.expected: Per the assignment, every one of the six forms fails lint AND the scan.
checks_run.actual:
Probe exit 0. Its per-form results are eslint/scan exit codes, and the assertions about them are mine.

Five forms fail both guards (eslint=1, scan=1): O1 Reflect.construct(Function), O3 createRequire()('vm'), O4 Reflect.apply(Function), O5 computed ['constructor'], and O6 alias F = Function.

O2, globalThis['ev'+'al'], gives eslint=0 and scan=1. Lint does not refuse it; only the scan's globalThis pattern does, as in round 1. The step-1 condition 'fail lint and the scan' is therefore not met for O2.

The supplement's X1 { constructor } destructuring, X2 Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(...).constructor and X3 globalThis.Function each give eslint=1 and scan=1. X2 and X3 give tsc=2, but that is my own snippets' type assertions and is informational only.

evaluate.ts was restored after each form, and git status was clean.

checks_run.environment: Disposable clone $TMPDIR/review-p2; PostgreSQL 16 (both clusters); Node 22 and Node 24
checks_run.procedure:
Code review of the ARCH-05 annotation path: gates.ts listGates, getGate and configureGate; portfolio loadInheritedApprovalFacts; and server.ts wiring. Then probe D, which sets up a Modular transformation with a verified-evidence G1 inherited approval accepted by the synthetic Sponsor:
- D1: three outsiders call list, view and PATCH: a same-org user without grants, the TL of a sibling business unit, and the other organization's TO.
- D2: twenty reads, then a checksum of gate_instance, gate_decision, gate_submission and gate_dispensation, and the audit_event count.
- D3: configureGate's response.
- D4: an inherited approval on unverified evidence.
checks_run.command: probe D (sec-r2-inherited-approval.test.ts) on 26310 (Node 22, LANG unset) and 26312 (Node 24, LANG=C.UTF-8); diff-scan S7/S7b
checks_run.expected: The annotation is visible only to readers. It never changes status, writes nothing, never makes a gate look approved, and does no client or remote I/O inside a transaction.
checks_run.actual:
Code review:
- Both GET handlers call requireTransformationRead before loading anything.
- loadInheritedApprovalFacts and loadDispensations are scoped WHERE transformation_id = :id, which is the same transformation and the same read gate as GET gate-dispensations.
- counts comes from the sequencing rule itself (hasInheritedApproval).
- In PATCH, the annotation is read after the write transaction commits, followed by requireTransformationRead; the transaction itself is unchanged.
- The added API lines contain no insert, update, delete or remote I/O (S7, S7b).

Probe D: 5/5 pass in both runs.
- D1: all three outsiders get 404 on list, view and PATCH, and no body contains the dispensation ID or the approving body.
- D2: the checksums are identical before and after the 20 reads (audit_event count 2113 → 2113). G1 stays draft with approved_at null and no gate_decision, even while counts is true.
- D3: PATCH by a transformation TO returns 200 with the annotation (accepted, counts true) and status draft.
- D4: accepting an inherited approval whose evidence is not verified is refused with 422 ('evidence must be verified before it can be accepted'). That guard is stronger than D4 assumed. The G2 annotation then shows pending_verification with counts false and status draft.

The suite's two new dispensations.test.ts tests (pending → accepted → revoked; End-to-End null) pass in both integration runs.

checks_run.procedure: Check that workflows does not import portfolio, that the new seam is injected by server.ts, and that architecture.test.ts pins the graph.
checks_run.command: diff-scan S2/S2b/S2c; git diff 928b7654..f49ca16 -- apps/api/src/server.ts apps/api/src/modules/workflows/index.ts
checks_run.expected: No workflows → portfolio edge; the graph stays acyclic.
checks_run.actual: No import of portfolio anywhere in modules/workflows (S2). portfolio imports a type (InheritedApprovalFact) from ../workflows/index.ts, which keeps the existing direction portfolio → workflows. workflows exports only the type and declares the third GateFactsProvider member. server.ts wires inheritedApprovals: loadInheritedApprovalFacts. When unwired, UNWIRED_GATE_FACTS returns [], so every gate shows null. architecture.test.ts asserts that no module's dependsOn contains portfolio, that workflows' dependsOn is unchanged, and that a DFS finds no cycle. It passes in both unit runs.

checks_run.procedure: Check that the GateInstance change is additive and nullable, that the zod mirror matches, and that contract.test.ts still pins 270 live operations with empty pending lists.
checks_run.command: diff-scan S5/S5b/S6/S12; git diff 928b7654..f49ca16 -- docs/api/openapi.yaml packages/shared/src/schemas/gate.ts
checks_run.expected: There is one new nullable property and one new schema; the zod mirror is identical in shape; 270 operations; every p3-pending list is empty.
checks_run.actual: OpenAPI: GateInstance gains the required inheritedApproval property, oneOf [GateInheritedApproval, null]. GateInheritedApproval is {dispensationId Uuid, status enum [pending_verification, accepted, rejected, revoked], counts boolean, approvingBody 1..300, approvedOn BusinessDate} with additionalProperties false. The zod mirror gateInheritedApproval is z.strictObject with the same five fields, enum, bounds and businessDate, and gateInstance has inheritedApproval: gateInheritedApproval.nullable(). No operation, status or other field changed. The only producer of GateInstance is gateView, used by list, view and PATCH. contract.test.ts passes in both runs with toHaveLength(270), and every operation is checked against its zod mirror. All seven p3-pending lists are empty. Observation, not raised: making the field 'required' is a change in the response shape for any external strict client. It is consistent with how the contract treats nullable fields, it ships together with the web, and it is documented in p3-work-split §9 item 24.

checks_run.procedure: Review the GatesPage.tsx and GateDetailPage.tsx diff: session-bound actions only, EN and AR translations, and no approved colour.

checks_run.expected: No navigation or cache primitive; identical EN/AR key sets; a neutral chip with no check icon.
checks_run.actual: The added web lines contain no useNavigate, .navigate(, setQueryData, window.location or dangerouslySetInnerHTML. The S8 hits are comments, test literals and the approvedOn field. The only link is a declarative <Link> to the dispensations page; the badge performs no action and no write. The EN and AR key sets of gates.inheritedApproval are identical (8 keys), and every state says it does not approve the gate. The badge is always status-chip--unknown with the info icon. approvingBody is rendered as React text, which is escaped. inherited-approval.test.tsx passes 16/16 in both unit runs, in EN LTR and AR RTL: the gate status stays draft, there is no on-track class and no check path, and 'Approved' is absent.
